# Cambridge HVAC Pro

> From its base in Cambridge, Waterloo Region, Cambridge HVAC Pro serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (548) 325-9317  |  Email: contact@cambridgehvacpro.ca  |  Website: https://cambridgehvacpro.ca

Service areas: Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
